author: Codex agent
sourceDiscovery: Consensus MCP search/fetch plus primary full-text/provider retrieval and FDA labels
scope: Bounded C3GN map: acquired convertase dysregulation, complement-regulatory and CFHR structural variants, glomerular complement deposition and variable renal course. Related mixed-C3G assay/cohort evidence and mixed-C3G/IC-MPGN trials retain separate contexts. Dense deposit disease and immune-complex GN are excluded as mapped phenotypes; their inclusion in cited studies is explicit. Selected proximal complement therapies include verified US indications through 2026-10-15; no universal causal circuit or comprehensive therapy catalog is claimed.
